sentences.text:
THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER SECTIONS 11 AND 12 OF THE CONTEMPT OF COURTS ACT 1971, PRAYING TO TAKE COGNIZANCE OF THE DISOBEDIENCE AND WILLFUL OF THE ORDER DATED 23.11.2021 PASSED IN W.P.NO.20464/2021 (LA-KIADB) AS PER ANNEXURE-A AND TO PUNISH THE ACCUSED NO.2 IN ACCORDANCE WITH LAW.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
VIJAYKUMAR A. PATIL J., MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This contempt petition is filed under Sections 11 and 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 complaining disobedience of the order of the learned Single Judge dated 23.11.2021 passed in W.P.No.20464/2021, wherein the learned Single Judge has passed the following order:
"Accordingly, the writ petitioner is disposed of directing respondent No.2 to consider the representation dated 14.10.2019 vide Annexure-D and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order."
2.

The accused have entered appearance and filed compliance affidavit, wherein paragraph No.5 reads as under:
"5.

I submit that, I have examined the representation of the compliant wherein he is seeking for payment of compensation on the NC: 2023:KHC:33516-DB basis of the preliminary notification dated 13.12.2018 and final notification dated 26.08.2019.
The name of the complaint is not forthcoming in the said notifications and also the joint measurement Survey certificate (J.M.C.).
Therefore the claim of the complaint was rejected and endorsement dated 08.09.2023 was issued to the complaint.
The copy of the endorsement dated 08.09.2023 is herewith produced and marked as Annexure R1.
Thus the order of the Hon'ble court at Annexure A has been duly complied with."
3. On perusal of the averments made in the compliance affidavit, it is evident that the accused has considered the representation of the petitioner as directed by the learned Single Judge.
In view of the compliance of the direction, the contempt proceedings are dropped with the liberty to the complainants to challenge the endorsement dated 08.09.2023, if so advised.
